notes.text:
This update for mozilla-nss fixes the following issue:

- remove compromised eMudhra Intermediates CA (bsc#1286261).

Changes for mozilla-nss:

- update to NSS 3.125.1 (bsc#1289144):
 * bmo#2088196 - backport nssckbi 2.92.
 * bmo#2082793 - Don't cache sessions when ECH was rejected.
 * bmo#2082792 - Keep DTLS handshake messages whole in the send buffer.
 * bmo#2082077 - Initialize sftk_MACCtx in sftk_MAC_Init.
 * bmo#2082027 - reorder session context setup in sftk_doMACInit.
 * bmo#2054723 - harden against integer overflows in lowpbe.c.
 * bmo#2054697 - fix AES GCM parameter serialization in pk11_GetPBECryptoMechanism.
 * bmo#2054695 - handle HMAC truncation when using PK11_Digest* APIs.
 * bmo#2054616 - reject short ciphertexts in sec_pkcs5_rc2.
